passage.quote:
The project covers one forward layer for one input vector. Its PTX formalization
contains the instruction forms, machine state, and execution rules needed by
the layer's kernel.

summary: Compute each output row in a separate thread using 1024 ordered FP32 fused multiply-adds, a rounded bias addition, and a maximum with positive zero.
Use 12 blocks of 256 threads and contiguous disjoint buffers, with 16 PTX instruction forms and private per-thread register state.
Select an in-range output row through formally modeled register updates, with launch counts supplied as parameters.
Form exact row, bias, and output pointers using a derived weight stride and explicit buffer-end bounds preventing 64-bit wraparound.
Load declared generic pointer parameters and convert them to supplied global buffers under explicit successful-conversion assumptions, preserving unrelated state.
Require the supplied input-word values for the single-thread final block, store its ordered result in exactly one word and preserve every other word address.
Execute the initialized dot-product loop with one supplied FMA update per column, correct pointer/counter progress and exit, while preserving memory and unrelated registers.
Execute the bias/ReLU/store/return suffix, store the specified row result, preserve other word locations and unrelated registers, and stop the entry thread.
Execute the complete computational block through its loop/suffix handoff, return with rowResult stored, and preserve all other word locations and unrelated registers.
Execute the concatenated four-block kernel per thread through return, store its ordered row result and preserve every other memory word.
Use concrete FloatLib binary32 addition and FMA, with direct proofs of agreement with their reference operations.
Decode finite preactivations and prove exact real ReLU with preservation of absolute-error bounds.
Bound the finite ordered FMA and bias-addition error by accumulated local half-ULP terms; ReLU preserves this bound on the stored row result.
Connect the finite stored kernel result directly to the real-valued upstream nn.Sequential forward coordinate on decoded inputs, using the existing rounding budget.
remaining: The per-thread modeled kernel is connected to the actual real-valued TorchLean Sequential forward coordinate on decoded inputs, under the existing memory and finite-row contracts and accumulated rounding budget. PTX arithmetic adequacy, CUDA memory refinement, concurrent GPU execution and hardware correspondence remain unproved.

The four kernel arguments are generic pointers to global buffers, in the order

passage.quote:
import ReluLayer.PTX.Machine

namespace ReluLayer.PTX

/-- Register names shared by all selected kernel blocks. -/
inductive Register where
  | thread | block | row
  | weightBase | inputRead | biasBase | outputBase
  | rowOffset | elementOffset | weightRead | biasRead | outputWrite
  | column | weightValue | inputValue | accumulator | more
  | biasValue | result
  deriving DecidableEq

def Register.ptxName : Register → String
  | .thread => "%thread"
  | .block => "%block"
  | .row => "%row"
  | .weightBase => "%W_base"
  | .inputRead => "%x_read"
  | .biasBase => "%b_base"
  | .outputBase => "%y_base"
  | .rowOffset => "%row_offset"
  | .elementOffset => "%element_offset"
  | .weightRead => "%W_read"
  | .biasRead => "%b_read"
  | .outputWrite => "%y_write"
  | .column => "%j"
  | .weightValue => "%w"
  | .inputValue => "%x"
  | .accumulator => "%acc"
  | .more => "%more"
  | .biasValue => "%bias"
  | .result => "%result"

private def operandText : Operand Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat
  | .tidX => "%tid.x"
  | .ctaidX => "%ctaid.x"

private def operand64Text : Operand64 Register → String
  | .reg r => r.ptxName
  | .imm v => toString v.toNat

/-- Render the selected instruction forms for executable source-fragment comparisons. -/
def Instruction.ptxText : Instruction Register → String
  | .mov dst src => s!"mov.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src};"
  | .madLo dst a b c =>
      s!"mad.lo.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .mulWide dst a b => s!"mul.wide.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .add64 dst a b => s!"add.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text a}, {operand64Text b};"
  | .ldParam64 dst symbol => s!"ld.param.u64 {dst.ptxName}, [{symbol}];"
  | .cvtaGlobal64 dst src => s!"cvta.to.global.u64 {dst.ptxName}, {operand64Text src};"
  | .movF32 dst value =>
      let digits := Nat.toDigits 16 value.toNat
      s!"mov.f32 {dst.ptxName}, 0f{String.ofList (List.replicate (8 - digits.length) '0' ++ digits)};"
  | .loadF32 dst address => s!"ld.global.f32 {dst.ptxName}, [{operand64Text address}];"
  | .fmaRN dst a b c => s!"fma.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b}, {operandText c};"
  | .add32 dst a b => s!"add.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .setpLt dst a b => s!"setp.lt.u32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .branchIf predicate target => s!"@{predicate.ptxName} bra PC_{target};"
  | .addF32RN dst a b => s!"add.rn.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText a}, {operandText b};"
  | .maxPositiveZero dst src => s!"max.f32 {dst.ptxName}, {operandText src}, 0f00000000;"
  | .storeF32 address src => s!"st.global.f32 [{operand64Text address}], {operandText src};"
  | .ret => "ret;"

end ReluLayer.PTX
